exposure: ultrasound and color Doppler features of PAS
cohort: 50 pregnant patients with placenta previa, gestational age ≥ 24 weeks, and history of at least one prior cesarean section
finding: Ultrasound demonstrated high accuracy (90%) in diagnosing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in patients with placenta previa and prior cesarean section, with a sensitivity of 94.7% and specificity of 87.1%.
